en: Sepia-toned early-20th‑century photograph of a group of finely dressed people (women in long dresses and large hats, men in suits and bowler/top hats) standing around a powerful indoor fountain or geyser. The scene is inside an ornate glass-and-iron pavilion with large arched windows and decorative ironwork. Steam or spray from the fountain fills the air, giving the image a hazy appearance.
